beats.story: After Cliff leaves, it's like a closed chapter: nothing from that job or those people can hurt me again, not if I don't want it to. The last gin bottle, taking a break on the coffee table, stares me down. Is it already time to start drinking again? I've had my coffee. It's not normal to think like this, but it must be a start that I'm realizing that. And I do want to start somewhere. It somehow feels like things can be okay, now that they're so broken. Now that there's nothing left to hold together, I can just deal with what's in front of me.
beats.story_cn: Cliff一走，这页就算彻底翻篇了：那份工作、那些人，再也伤不到我分毫——只要我不愿意。茶几上那最后一瓶金酒，正歇在那里，死死盯着我。难道是时候重新开始喝了吗？咖啡我已经喝过了。这么想不太对劲，但至少能意识到这点，倒也算是个开头。我也确实想重新开始。说不清为什么，总觉得事情还能好转——既然已经碎得这么彻底。既然没什么好维系的了，我反而能安心面对眼前的一切。

beats.story: Where I'm going, I don't know, but I can put some garbage away. That's all I have to do. Next, I have to shower. That's only standing somewhere where water happens to be falling. Nobody can blame me for that. Once I manage to get myself washed and into a clean pair of sweats and less dirty hoodie, I find a way to gather the trash and the bottles and take them out. I spend about six hours tidying, and it isn't anything like I'd built in my head. After I make myself a can of soup, I spend a good half hour looking at my face in the mirror.
beats.story_cn: 鬼知道要去哪儿，但我可以先把垃圾扔掉。这就够了。接下来，得冲个澡。不过就是站在水往下浇的地方罢了。总没人能怪我吧。等我总算把自己洗干净，套上一件干净运动裤和稍微干净点的连帽衫后，才想办法收拾起垃圾和瓶子，拎了出去。我花了大约六个小时整理房间，结果和脑子里预想的完全不一样。给自己开了罐汤后，我又对着镜子端详起自己的脸，足足有半个小时。

beats.story: Mostly, I try to look myself in the eye. I find my phone. It's been out of battery for days. I plug it in before I go to bed. I get out of bed at the respectable hour of eight a.m. I shower and manage to take some laundry downstairs. I go to the store and get groceries and buy a new vacuum that is a pain in the ass to assemble. I'm heating up a bowl of vegetable soup when I finally make eye contact with my phone.
beats.story_cn: 主要是，我试着直视自己的眼睛。我找到了手机，它已经断电好几天了。睡前我把它插上充电。第二天早上八点，这个还算体面的时间，我起了床。洗了澡，设法把一堆待洗衣物拎下楼。我去商店买了菜，还买了个新吸尘器——组装起来麻烦得要命。最后热一碗蔬菜汤时，我才终于和手机屏幕对上了视线。

beats.story: Worried about what is the question. Because a party that's basically in her honor being ruined might be the biggest tragedy of them all. I need to call her. But as I grab my empty glasses from the bedside table, I hear Miley say from outside my window, "Sorry, but Jolene asked me not to let you into the building anymore." Then my mom says, "This is very disrespectful . . ." I sprint to the front hall before things get bad. "Mom, come in. I was just getting some tea made." Mom's face is pinched as her gaze searches mine, the disappointment already apparent.
beats.story_cn: 担忧什么才是正题。毕竟一场基本为她举办的派对若被搞砸，恐怕是所有灾难里最惨痛的那桩。我必须给她打电话。但当我从床头柜抓起空眼镜时，却听见麦莉在窗外说："抱歉，乔琳叫我别再让你进楼了。"接着我妈的声音响起："这实在很失礼……"我冲到前厅，赶在事态恶化前开口："妈，进来吧。我正要泡茶。"母亲脸色一沉，目光在我脸上逡巡，失望已清晰可见。

beats.story: "Jolene, what are you doing? Armin says you broke up, and you don't tell me? So many people have asked me if things are still okay for the party. Why aren't you answering my messages?" "Sorry, I wasn't feeling good." I pull the door wide to my thankfully cleaner abode. "Drink some tea and eat fruit." She storms through my apartment and straight to my fridge. She'll be angry that I don't have something like pomegranates on hand. "I just ate a bunch of melon," I lie. "Hopefully I'll feel better soon." She nods, satisfied for now.
beats.story_cn: “乔琳，你在搞什么？阿尔敏说你们分手了，你居然都不告诉我？好多人问我派对还办不办。为什么不回我消息？”“抱歉，我不太舒服。”我把门拉开，幸好屋里还算整洁。“喝点茶，吃点水果。”她一阵风似的穿过我的公寓直奔冰箱。她会气我没备石榴之类的水果。“我刚吃了一堆哈密瓜，”我撒谎道，“希望很快就能好起来。”她点点头，暂时被安抚了。

beats.story: "Why did you and Armin break up?" I shake my head, bracing for the terrible Band-Aid I'm about to rip. "No. That was all a lie -- we were never dating . . ." Her face drops. "Or engaged." She stares almost through me. I expect her to drill into me with a million questions about it, but instead she says, "But are you okay? Would you still like to have a celebration.
beats.story_cn: “你和阿尔敏为什么分手？”我摇摇头，准备撕开这令人难受的创可贴。“不。那全是谎言——我们从未交往过……”她的脸色垮了下来。“也从未订婚。”她几乎要洞穿我。我本以为她会连珠炮似地追问，但她却问道：“可你还好吗？派对还想继续办吗？”

beats.story: One for your promotion?" A chuckle escapes through the hollow part of my chest. I'm so far away from the person she thinks I am. I inhale, and it's like the words come flying out of me. "I'm really not doing good." I fall onto my couch and put my head in my hands. After a beat, I feel the cushion beside me sink. "I haven't been good since Ellie -- or even before that. I know you've been trying to help me move on and lead a good life, but it's not happening." I gasp for air, peering at her from between my fingers as her eyes widen. Her lips press into a line.
beats.story_cn: “为了升职那事儿？”一声轻笑从我胸膛的空洞里逸出。离她以为的那个我，我早已相去甚远。我深吸一口气，话语便如离弦之箭般飞出：“我真的不好。”我跌进沙发，把脸埋进掌心。片刻后，我感到身旁的坐垫塌陷下去。“自从艾莉走后——甚至更早，我就没好过。我知道你一直想帮我走出来，过上正常生活，但这没用。”我喘息着，从指缝间瞥她，看见她双眼圆睁。她的嘴唇抿成了一条线。

options.fullOutcomeStory_cn: 压力的突然爆发引出一句怪异的评论，在安静的办公室里回荡。你立刻为口无遮拦感到懊悔。

beats.story: After she leaves, I'm not as settled as I'd like. One niggling thought keeps eating at me. Before I think too hard, I send the text. Would you like to have lunch, just us, next week? As soon as it's marked delivered, I stop breathing. But the answer doesn't come. I need to unsend. I want to throw my phone into a garbage can and forget I ever sent it.
beats.story_cn: 她离开后，我远没有想象中平静。一个念头如鲠在喉，在我细细思索之前，消息已发送出去："下周一起吃午饭，就我们俩，好吗？"显示"已送达"的瞬间，我屏住了呼吸。答案却迟迟不来。我必须撤回。我想把手机扔进垃圾桶，假装这条消息从未存在。
